A marker for each fabric: nest --material NAME [skip ci]

ar: ماركر لكل قماش: خيار جديد يجعل الماركر يحمل قطع خامة واحدة فقط (البطانة أو الحشو في ماركر خاص بعرضه)

The owner's choice: «ماركر لكل قماش». An order's file with pieces of two fabrics (the garment's fabric and a lining)
was nested into one marker. `nest FILE --material NAME` (repeatable) makes a marker with the pieces of these materials
only — exactly these; a material the file does not have is said, nothing is made. LEVEL7 MTM 2.0.25 asks for one
marker for each fabric of an order, each at its own width.
tests/test_review_2.py::test_a_marker_for_each_fabric (fails on 2.0.23).
